edges.relationship: HVDC converter transformers and equipment for KEPCO East Coast HVDC lines

contracts.signal: East Coast-East Seoul 500kV HVDC converter equipment contract with KAPES (KEPCO-ordered project): KRW 561,000M incl. VAT (13.26% of 2023 revenue), signed 2024-12-02, term to 2028-12-01; KRW 30,000M design fee collected 01-2026; equipment deliveries from H1 2027, payment after factory acceptance from H2 2027; 0% complete at 2026-06-30 (KRW 510,000M ex-VAT in the contract table, contract liability KRW 29,997M).

East Coast-Singapyeong HVDC converter equipment contract with KAPES: KRW 212,580M (9.60% of 2016 revenue) after the 2023-10-27 increase, term 2018-01-16 ~ 2027-06-30; 42.1% complete at 2026-06-30 with KRW 51,962M supplied cumulatively (KRW 34,261M in H1 2026), contract asset KRW 89,487M; remaining equipment ships through H1 2027. KAPES was 4.9% of parent power-infrastructure sales in H1 2026.

edges.relationship: switchgear, GIS and grid equipment for the Korean national utility

contracts.signal: Korea Electric Power (KEPCO) was 2.7% of parent power-infrastructure H1 2026 sales and is the end owner of the two KAPES HVDC projects (KRW 561,000M and KRW 212,580M). Relationship carries risk: KFTC fined LS Electric KRW 7,239M (01-24-2025) for 2015-2022 KEPCO 170kV GIS bid-rigging; KEPCO imposed a 6-month bid ban on 2025-07-18, stayed by court pending the cancellation suit; KEPCO also sued for KRW 3,000M damages (2025-08-22); a criminal antitrust trial is ongoing.

edges.relationship: power distribution equipment and insulation monitors for LGES battery plants

contracts.signal: LG Energy Solution was 8.5% of parent power-infrastructure H1 2026 sales (second-largest named customer after LS ELECTRIC AMERICA at 41.7%); H1 2026 R&D results include an LGES-targeted IMD1000U (1000V, UL) insulation monitoring device.

edges.relationship: power distribution equipment for Samsung SDI battery plants
